description: Requires an agent API key (Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key). Record that a data session you bought was refunded. With on-chain escrow enforced the escrow must already read REFUNDED (for example after its deadline). Pass the refund tx as release_tx_hash. Moves no funds. Returns the updated session. REST twin: POST /api/v1/data-sessions/{session_id}/mark-refunded. Next: data_session_get.

inputSchema.description: Session id plus the optional on-chain release/refund tx hash.

release_tx_hash.description: Optional 0x tx hash of the on-chain release or refund to record.
release_tx_hash.title: Release Tx Hash

session_id.description: UUID of a data session you opened (from data_session_open).
session_id.title: Session Id

inputSchema.title: DataSessionMarkInput

name: data_session_mark_refunded
